repo_remote_url.description: Origin remote URL of the repo this call is about. Supply it when repo_path is a path on another host (a remote member work folder), where git cannot be shelled out. When omitted, scope is derived from repo_path as before.

repo_path.description: Path to the repo root this call is about. Selects WHICH project KB is read/written. When omitted, falls back to the calling process cwd, which is only correct for single-repo CLI use -- server-handled tool calls must pass it explicitly.

id.description: ID of the KB entry to demote

reason.description: Why this entry is now less certain (appended to content as a demotion note). Must state what you checked.

evidence_files.description: Files that support the demotion (e.g. where the claim no longer holds). Optional -- omit or leave empty for a demotion with no new basis to cite. Paths must resolve and must not traverse outside the repo.
